title: A Centroid Framework for Operator-Valued Haagerup Inequalities
summary: We introduce a centroid-based block decomposition of the left-regular representation and use it to prove operator-valued Haagerup inequalities for finitely generated groups with centroid maps. The decomposition separates the three centroid growth conditions into distinct operator-norm contributions and, under a factorization hypothesis for the associated Schur multipliers, yields complementary lower bounds.
